title: Rollers button
description: The plant-hire site's buttons: an orange rectangle with 3px corners for the main action, and charcoal or white pills for the quieter one, usually set side by side with no gap. Every variant fades to an olive grey on hover over 0.45s.
notes: the light pill is for coloured bands (bg-accent); its text turns to the page colour on hover
pairs sit flush: put two in a plain flex row without a gap
